🧭 Choose Your Career

The biggest question: "What should I become?" No one else can answer this. The answer lives in your own mind. ACS's Career Interest Test brings that answer out.

❓ What is this test?

Plain truth first: this is a test that measures interest. It is not an exam of aptitude or knowledge. No answer is right or wrong. The questions come from daily life: home, farm, market, mobile, games. You simply say what you like and what you don't.

Progress is faster in work your heart enjoys. That is why schools and companies worldwide run interest tests like this. In villages, many people never hear that such a test exists. Now you know.

The science behind it: the globally recognized RIASEC interest science, since 1959. Inspired by it, the ACS engine measures your interest across 24 sectors from your answers.

🧬 Science and limits: the full truth

The framework is based on / inspired by RIASEC (1959). RIASEC has 6 types of interests. ACS's 18,943 questions are built from its own list of 951 enterprise categories. The counting is done by machine, not written by hand. Every question carries its sector details in advance. From this, the scores for 24 sectors are made.

The counting is plain math: no AI creates your result. Question selection is dynamic (dynamic question selection): the middle parts of the full test go deeper into your strong sectors. We make no bigger technical claim than this.

The plain truth about limits: ACS's own scoring model is still in its validation phase. Figures such as pilot samples and reliability are not yet published. Having 18,943 questions is not, by itself, scientific proof. That is why the result is advice, not a verdict. Confirm it further with a counsellor or your own experience.

✅ What does the Golden Pass include right now?

120-question Career Interest Test take it as many times as you like, all year; no separate 100 rupees per attempt. The result shows with it; no separate result-fee.

Site-wide pass rule: wherever a future ACS service shows “GOLDEN PASS INCLUDED” written on it, the active pass covers that service. The ₹125 printable report, paid certificates or other separate-fee services are not covered by the pass unless that service clearly says “Golden Pass Included”.

🪪 How to get the Golden Pass?

  1. First login to your ACS account.
  2. Student role: complete registration there; the correct date of birth (DOB) is required.
  3. Dashboard → Golden Badge / Golden Pass: open it.
  4. The server derives your payment-day age from your DOB and sets the correct fee itself; village/town/metro rates do not apply to Student Golden.
  5. Pay the shown amount only through the official Razorpay checkout.
  6. As soon as the payment signature is verified, the Student Golden Pass becomes active instantly for 365 days. If a badge is already active or pending, do not buy again.

🎓 Discount for ages under 18

The minimum age is 10 years. For every full year below 18, 12% of the ₹300 base fee, i.e. ₹36, is deducted. The server derives your age from DOB on the payment day. Under-18 payments must be made with a guardian's consent.
